_schema: steps[] runs as a sequence of stages. Each entry is either:
_schema_object: - an object: a single step that runs alone, waits for previous stage to finish
_schema_array: - an array of step objects: those steps run in PARALLEL within the same stage
_schema_kinds: Three step kinds (each a JSON object with a `name` field):
_schema_download: download_install: HTTP-download `url`, then run with `args` (silent flags).
_schema_script: run_script:       write `script` verbatim to a temp .cmd and execute via cmd /c.
_schema_script_ref: or use `script_ref` (resolved at parse time to a script
_schema_script_ref3: batch bodies out of this JSON file).
_schema_extract: download_extract: HTTP-download `url`, extract via tar.exe to `extract_to`
_schema_extract2: (or a temp dir if empty), then optionally run `script` with
_schema_virtio: virtio drivers are NOT downloaded here anymore: the
_schema_virtio2: domain attaches virtio-win.iso and the autounattend PnP
_schema_virtio4: the offline image, so the guest boots virtio from first boot.
_schema_ivshmem: There is deliberately NO IVSHMEM driver step here. The driver is fetched ON THE HOST during the payload phase (IvshmemDriverFetcher downloads the Looking Glass host package into the data dir; IvshmemDriver::locate unpacks it), staged onto the payload ISO, and injected into the offline image by the autounattend (<DriverPaths> for \ivshmem) — so the device is live on the FIRST boot. It has to be: the shared-memory channel is the transport the agent talks over, and a driver delivered over that channel cannot bootstrap it. The guest-side fallback that used to live here was that circular bootstrap wearing a hat; a host that cannot obtain the driver now reports a failed download in the wizard, which is a thing a user can act on, instead of a PCI device that silently is not there.
_schema_gt: virtio-win-guest-tools is run FROM the mounted virtio-win.iso
_schema_gt2: (no download) for the non-boot extras: qemu-ga, Balloon service,
_schema_gt3: viosock WSP belt-and-suspenders. The CDs are ejected by the
_schema_promote: Admin promotion is NOT a setup step: it runs from C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\SetupComplete.cmd → LswPromote.ps1 (SYSTEM, before first AutoLogon) so the account is admin when LSA builds its logon token — no re-logon needed. The autounattend <Group>Administrators> is live-proven not to stick on Win11 26200 and `net localgroup /add` fails 1317 there; PowerShell Add-LocalGroupMember works.
_schema_no_guesttools: virtio-win-guest-tools is intentionally NOT installed. All virtio drivers (viostor/NetKVM/viosock/Balloon/viorng) are already PnP-injected by the autounattend at install; nothing in LSW consumes the bundle's extras — qemu-ga has no virtio-serial channel wired, the Balloon service has no work (fixed RAM), SPICE is unused (LSW renders via its own Vulkan-ICD proxy + VNC). Running the bundle only reinstalled NetKVM and reset the NIC the agent's RPC rides on → recurring 'stuck in virtio install'. If host-driven graceful shutdown / fsfreeze snapshots are wanted later, add <channel name='org.qemu.guest_agent.0'> to domain.xml AND install just guest-agent\qemu-ga-x86_64.msi (the no-NIC-touch MSI) then.
